questions.stem: A contractor designates a competent person for excavations but gives that person no authority to stop work or correct hazards. What is the main deficiency?
options: A competent person must be capable of identifying hazards and have authorization to take prompt corrective measures
The designation is valid as long as it appears on a daily form
Authority is unnecessary when a superintendent is somewhere on the project
The person must hold a CSP credential for every excavation
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Competence includes both knowledge and authority to act. A title without correction authority does not meet the operational role.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The option 'The designation is valid as long as it appears on a daily form' does not apply the controlling principle for competent person authority to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

The option 'Authority is unnecessary when a superintendent is somewhere on the project' does not apply the controlling principle for competent person authority to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.
The option 'The person must hold a CSP credential for every excavation' does not apply the controlling principle for competent person authority to the facts given, so it is not the best answer.

questions.stem: At a trench protective-system review, a supervisor proposes: "The designation is valid as long as it appears on a daily form". The underlying case is: A contractor designates a competent person for excavations but gives that person no authority to stop work or correct hazards. What is the main deficiency? Which alternative is the most defensible correction?
options: The person must hold a CSP credential for every excavation
Authority is unnecessary when a superintendent is somewhere on the project
The designation is valid as long as it appears on a daily form
A competent person must be capable of identifying hazards and have authorization to take prompt corrective measures
questions.correctAnswerExplanation: Competence includes both knowledge and authority to act. A title without correction authority does not meet the operational role.
incorrectOptionExplanations: The proposed response 'The person must hold a CSP credential for every excavation' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling competent person authority principle.
The proposed response 'Authority is unnecessary when a superintendent is somewhere on the project' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling competent person authority principle.
The proposed response 'The designation is valid as long as it appears on a daily form' remains incomplete or misapplies the controlling competent person authority principle.
